title: evaluator/mapping.json
description: The one mapping a command or sealed-brief-agent evaluator's judgment rows are converted through (AD-21): each key the evaluator prints binds to an oracle and the behavior it answers, or to a rubric criterion and its anchored scale levels. tea-evaluate check holds every binding to the contract. The tea-evaluate runtime owns this schema.

keys.description: Each judgment-row key the evaluator may print, with what it binds to. A row whose key is not here fails the judgment-rows schema.

Key.description: A key the evaluator prints: letters, digits, underscore, dot, colon or hyphen, starting with a letter or digit, at most 128 characters.

OracleBinding.description: A key whose pass row holds the oracle and whose fail row violates it, filing a defect finding for the behavior at the behavior's declared severity.

RubricBinding.description: A key whose score row becomes the criterion's judge result; levels restates the rubric's anchored scale levels, which check holds equal.
